text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. When a developer finishes writing a piece of code, a teammate reviews it before it is merged into the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, saving time and money compared to fixing problems after release. Beyond finding errors, reviews are a fantastic tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other’s styles and discover new techniques. Most importantly, they build a shared sense of responsibility for the overall quality of the code. Because everyone knows their work will be examined, they tend to write cleaner, more thoughtful code. Ultimately, regular code reviews make the whole team stronger and the final product more reliable.
